Title: Verify hovering over 'Point Me' reveals the Mobiles and Laptops menu
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Scroll to 'Mouse Hover' 2. Move the mouse over the 'Point Me' button 3. Read the dropdown menu items

Title: Verify double-clicking 'Copy Text' copies Field1 into Field2
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Enter text in Field1 2. Double-click the 'Copy Text' button 3. Read Field2
Expected Result: Field2 contains exactly the Field1 text

Title: Verify drag and drop of 'Drag me to my target' onto the drop box
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Scroll to 'Drag and Drop' 2. Drag the 'Drag me to my target' box 3. Drop it on the 'Drop here' box 4. Read the target text

Title: Verify the slider minimum handle moves with the keyboard and updates the price range
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Handle: minimum; Key: Right Arrow x 25
Steps: 1. Scroll to 'Slider' 2. Read the initial price range 3. Focus the left handle and press Right Arrow 25 times 4. Read the price range
Expected Result: Range minimum increases from $75 to $100; range text changes

Title: Verify the slider maximum handle moves with the keyboard and updates the price range

Steps: 1. Scroll to 'Slider' 2. Focus the right handle and press Left Arrow 50 times 3. Read the price range
